system.description:
You have learned to turn aside the fang and talon of the wild, shrugging off the natural attacks of beasts as though they were nothing.

Prerequisites: Animalism (2), Fortitude (4). Spend two Blood Traits and specify a type of animal — wolf, deer, bear, and so on. For the next hour, the effects of Fortitude are doubled when soaking damage from that type of animal. Damage that penetrates these and your other defenses remains in effect after Claw Immunity wears off, without modification. Soaking the bite or claw of a wolf-form Lupine may be permitted at the Storyteller's discretion, though such creatures are not truly animals.
